text: Mama... count to a hundred... and then come find me...
Mama, is it on? Is it recording? Hello, the future! I am Liesl and I am six and a half.
This is Herr Tamtam. He drums when he is happy. Drum, Herr Tamtam! (tin drumming)
♪ Komm mit, kleiner Soldat... ♪ I forget the rest. Mama, what comes next?
I'm not tired. I'm only resting my eyes. Like Papa used to.
Mama, when you go down in the salt, does it hum for you too?
Mama, is it recording? Is it— Hallo! This is Liesl! Herr Tamtam says hallo too!
...one, two, three, four... ...Mama, I did it!
